verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.trymartin.com that indexes the docs as markdown links, and the cited doc pages are served as raw .md files, so an agent can be pointed at them directly. The 404 on introduction.md.md comes from a doubled extension, while the .md pages themselves resolve. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other consolidated agent-oriented bundle, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
